raw_segments.text: Cleopatra, ah, dear, if I be so, from my cold heart let heaven and gender hail and poison
it in the source, and the first stone drop in my neck, as it determines, so dissolve
The next Cesarean smite, till by degrees the memory of my womb together with my brave
Egyptians all, by the descandying of this pelleted storm, lie graveless, till the flies
and gnats of Nile have buried them for prey.
